experiment: Nested training-fold learning curve: one fixed random validation/test split
selection: Minimum original-three-state autonomous validation MSE; all eight selections frozen before any test
test: One fixed test fold, eight predeclared training sizes; no test-based selection
training_balance: Within each TRAIN history, active and quiet transitions share equal total weight if both exist; replica-balanced. Active means release>1e-6kg/s OR absolute water/fuel change>1e-5kg per step.
evaluation: Unweighted full histories, active and quiet separately; train-defined normalization only
history: four states ending at current time; repeat initial state for missing history, never future truth
architecture: Plain four-state residual GRU 25->32->4, 5796 parameters; no gates or constraints
physics: No positivity, monotonicity or cessation constraints
burn_in: GRU memory initialized zero; teacher-forced prefix up to each training window recomputed with current parameters under no_grad; gradients within window only. Full autonomous evaluation uses predicted states from initial time, never true future states.
thermal_loss: Original four-state normalized squared error sum/3
scorecard: Frozen scorecard-v1, meaningful stable active/quiet/weak and transition windows at all forecast horizons. Primary selection remains original3state full autonomous validation MSE. Activity thresholds never tuned on predictions.

learning_curve.limitation: One split and one nested order/initialization; not ten complete learning curves. Same epochs do not imply equal optimizer updates; record updates and caps.
